result.prompt: A bold promotional Instagram feed graphic in a vertical 4:5 composition, designed as a striking red-and-white cut-paper poster. A large white circular discount sticker dominates the upper-middle of a saturated vermilion-red background, tilted slightly clockwise, with a small curled lower-right edge revealing a pale pink underside and casting a crisp, short shadow. The only text reads exactly “20% OFF · This weekend only”, arranged across three centered lines within the sticker: “20%” at the top in enormous condensed, heavy display lettering, “OFF” directly beneath in equally assertive red capitals, and “· This weekend only” below in smaller, highly legible red sans-serif lettering, with generous spacing separating the headline from the supporting line. Keep the entire phrase clearly readable, with no other lettering, logos, numerals, or symbols. Oversized white paper arcs enter from the upper-left and lower-right corners, framing the sticker without crowding its typography; a few short white radial rays emphasize the central offer. The viewpoint is straight-on, with restrained studio-style illumination from the upper left adding subtle paper grain and dimensional edge shadows. Crisp vector-like contours, matte paper textures, confident asymmetry, generous red negative space, and strong typographic hierarchy create a polished contemporary retail campaign aesthetic.
